Netflix Insights Dashboard

Python · Pandas · Streamlit
  • Interactive dashboard on a Netflix viewing dataset (customer, region, plan, category, rating, watch date, watch time, revenue) with filters for region, plan, category and date range.
  • Cleaned and validated data with Pandas: required-column checks, date and numeric conversion, and error handling for missing or invalid values.
  • 4 KPI cards and 4 charts built with groupby and resample aggregations.
  • Data quality panel (row count, missing values, duplicates), filtered-data CSV download, custom Netflix-style theme, deployed on Streamlit Cloud.
